environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) in us-east-1 VPC running the Flask monolith directly exposed via public ALB with no listener rules beyond default forward-to-target-group. Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No WAF attached. Instance is in a public subnet with the ALB forwarding all traffic to port 8080.

config.alb: internet-facing, default listener rule forwards to target group
